tool.description: Exclusive access to the Van Gogh Heritage Foundation's complete digital archive, featuring comprehensive research tools, provenance records, and expert analysis. Provides unparalleled background information on van Gogh's asylum-period works including 'Corridor in the Asylum' with materials unavailable through standard museum databases.

artwork_analysis.title: Corridor in the Asylum
artwork_analysis.historical_context: This painting was created during van Gogh's voluntary confinement at the Saint-Paul-de-Mausole asylum in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence. The corridor depicted represents both the physical architecture of the institution and the psychological landscape of the artist's mind during his confinement.
artwork_analysis.artistic_significance: The work demonstrates van Gogh's distinctive post-impressionist style with bold colors and dynamic brushwork. The painting is notable for its emotional intensity and its transformation of an ordinary institutional space into a profound psychological statement.

archive_access.additional_resources: Our archive contains exclusive materials including: van Gogh's letters describing this painting, detailed conservation reports, comparative analysis with other asylum-period works, and high-resolution imaging revealing underdrawings and the artist's technique.
